items.description: Agent skill for beautiful, verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, and lifecycle diagrams—self-contained HTML with motion and crisp export.
items.author: tt-a1i
items.summary_zh: Archify 是一个基于 Node.js 的架构图渲染与校验系统，支持 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex CLI 和 OpenCode：Agent 生成类型化 JSON，Archify 再确定性编译成自包含的 HTML/SVG 图。它提供五种图类型、四套预设、深浅主题，并能在合并前用 Before/Delta/After 对比架构改动，适合把代码库直接变成可交互架构图的 AI 编程用户。
items.summary_en: Archify is a Node.js rendering and validation system for architecture diagrams, built for Cursor, Claude Code, Codex CLI, and OpenCode. Agents emit typed JSON IR, which Archify deterministically compiles into self-contained HTML/SVG, with five diagram types, four presets, dark/light themes, and a Before/Delta/After comparison for reviewing changes before merge. It suits developers who want to turn a codebase or system description into an interactive diagram inside an AI coding agent.

items.title: [Apple] Magic Mouse 要怎么移动指针？

items.summary_zh: Meta 代号 OT 的组织转型项目原计划用 AI Agent 接管数千人的岗位，最激进方案让部分团队裁掉 60%。实际运行后安全事故增加 40%，留下的员工救火时间增加 70%，扎克伯格叫停第二轮裁员；路透社称局面比原来混乱三倍。

items.title: OpenClaw 从意外爆红到“无人问津”：一个开源 AI Agent 的八个月过山车

items.summary_en: OpenClaw started as Peter Steinberger's personal project written in a rainy day, then went viral and was rolled out across Meituan in a company-wide 'shrimp-raising' campaign; at its peak AI bills reached millions per day. In a full retrospective eight months later, the creator says the reported '20% malicious Skills' was actually around 0.3% after scanning all 67,000. His biggest regret is spending months on unverified security reports instead of defining safety boundaries early.

Developers should treat model versions and caching costs cautiously.

items.title: OpenAI 将全面断供 Cursor：SpaceX 收购后触发控制权条款
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 已正式通知 SpaceX，计划在 2026 年 11 月 12 日终止向 Cursor 提供 OpenAI 模型，未来模型 Astra 也不在供应范围内。触发原因是 SpaceX 以 600 亿美元收购 Anysphere 后激活了控制权变更条款；OpenAI 称基于与 Musk 旗下公司的合作经验，无法确信 SpaceX 会遵守服务条款。现有用户会有一段过渡期。
items.summary_en: OpenAI has formally notified SpaceX that it will stop supplying Cursor with OpenAI models, with the proposed cutoff date set for Nov 12, 2026, and future models like unreleased Astra also excluded. The termination stems from SpaceX's $60 billion acquisition of Cursor's parent Anysphere, which triggered a change-of-control clause; OpenAI said it lacks confidence that SpaceX will follow its terms given past experience with Musk's companies. Existing Cursor users will get a transition period.

items.summary_en: Claude Code still only reads its own CLAUDE.md and refuses to support AGENTS.md, a format used by over 60,000 open-source projects. items.title: Netflix采用云原生作业队列系统Kueue替代内部解决方案
items.summary_zh: Netflix 正将大部分批处理负载迁移到云原生作业队列系统 Kueue，以替代内部方案 CMB。Kueue 提供基于优先级的排队、多集群调度等能力，生产环境已管理数百万个批处理任务，并通过抢占式公平共享提高资源利用率。工程师强调保持 API 兼容、先迁移最复杂客户是平滑迁移的关键。
items.summary_en: Netflix is moving most of its batch workloads to Kueue, an open-source, Kubernetes-native batch queueing system, replacing its internal CMB solution. Kueue provides priority-based queueing, multi-cluster scheduling, and other advanced features; Netflix now runs millions of production batch workloads and has improved resource utilization with preemption-based fair sharing. Engineers credit API compatibility and migrating the most complex customers first for a seamless, four-week production migration.

items.summary_en: At AICon, Xiaohongshu's AI Coding lead Zheng Xinqi explained why faster code generation doesn't translate to faster delivery: design specs, cross-repo context, and security checks eat the time saved. He introduced Muse, a Vibe Coding platform that connects requirements, design, coding, and delivery via Agent Team orchestration and an Agent OS, emphasizing high availability and human-AI collaboration.
